SOBRE NÓS A Brudovan Pneus foi fundada em 1973, na cidade de Campinas, pelo Sr. Domenico Micaroni e atualmente, a empresa é liderada por seus filhos, Domenico Micaroni Junior e Bruno Micaroni. Atuamos no comércio varejista e atacadista de peças, pneus e serviços, consolidando nossa presença em diferentes segmentos do mercado. Desde o início, com apenas uma loja de Auto Center, já contávamos com uma equipe de operações e de vendas altamente capacitada e atuávamos em um mercado em franca expansão. Esses fatores foram cruciais para nosso rápido crescimento e sucesso. Atualmente, possuímos quatro lojas na região de Campinas. Além disso, somos distribuidores exclusivos de pneus Michelin e óleo Castrol para motocicletas no estado de São Paulo. Expandimos nossas operações para outros estados estratégicos. Em Minas Gerais, o segundo maior mercado consumidor do Brasil, trabalhamos com marcas renomadas como Michelin, Levorin e Cobreq. No estado da Bahia, somos os distribuidores exclusivos da Motul. Nosso destaque no setor é evidente: somos o maior distribuidor de pneus Michelin do Brasil e estamos entre os três principais distribuidores da Levorin no país. Em nível internacional, figuramos entre os cinco maiores distribuidores Michelin 2R na América Latina. Atuação profissional de acordo com as diretrizes organizacionais, em estreita integração e colaboração com o time comercial e operacional das lojas, assegurando um excelente atendimento aos clientes no balcão, fomentando as vendas dos produtos e serviços de maior interesse para a empresa, realizando orçamentos de maneira ágil e assertiva, apresentando todo o portifólio, auxiliando os clientes nas tomadas de decisão quando aos serviços a serem realizados RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕESAtendimento de clientes no balcão da loja, prezando pela qualidade, prazo e fidelização dos clientes; Elaboração de orçamentos e direcionamento dos serviços para o time operacional para atendimento da demanda do cliente; Contribuir para a tomada de decisão do cliente quanto a questões técnicas dos serviços e produtos ofertados; Realizar os registros dos atendimentos no sistema da empresa e cumprir os processos diários tais como: checklist, pós-venda e apontamento; Emitir Nota fiscal dos produtos e serviços vendidos dentro do sistema da empresa; Responsável pela organização e limpeza ponto de venda; Orientar os clientes quanto as garantias dos serviços prestados; Realizar ações ativas para captação de clientes.  REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕESEnsino médio completo Experiência em vendas no segmento automotivo será considerado um diferencial; Habilidades de comunicação e persuasão, que saiba construir e desenvolver oportunidades; Motivação, persistência e agilidade noss atendimentos; Trabalho em Equipe, empatia e inteligência emocional. JOB MISSION   The Product Engineer (Level II) at HwIT is a key technical contributor bridging RD innovation and global manufacturing. This professional actively supports the industrialization cycle  from first RD prototypes through NPI delivery to mass production  executing BOM control, product cost modeling, and equipment management for NPI, helping our customers  products achieve world-class manufacturing quality, competitive costs, and scalable production.   SCOPE  RESPONSIBILITIES   1.  Product Lifecycle  Financial Control  ·       BOM Management for Complex Products: Execute technical ownership of Bills of Materials, ensuring structural integrity, component traceability, and alignment with engineering changes.  ·       Product Cost Control: Assist in developing and maintaining detailed product cost models, tracking cost drivers around materials and processes, and supporting cost reduction initiatives.  ·       Engineering Change Control (ECR/ECN): Support the Engineering Change Request and Engineering Change Notice cycle, documenting modifications, capturing lessons learned, and evaluating industrial feasibility and cost impacts.  2.  Process Design, NPI, and Global Transference  ·       Process Flow, Requirements  Documentation: Assist in defining assembly process flows, line requirements, and maintaining comprehensive manufacturing documentation. Support process validations and failure analysis arising from process deviations.  ·       NPI Equipment Management: Help define technical specifications for production equipment and materials, tracking procurement activities in collaboration with RD and Manufacturing teams.  ·       Manufacturing Capacity Model: Develop and update assembly line capacity models, collecting yields and process times to assist in ensuring production scalability and feeding capacity utilization data into cost models.  ·       RD to Manufacturing Bridge: Execute the technical transference of validated processes from RD labs to high-volume manufacturing sites under senior technical guidance.  ·       Global Product  Process Support: Travel to Asia, Europe, and the Americas to provide on-site support for manufacturing technology learning, process debugging, yield improvement, and failure analysis.  ·       Equipment Transference Logistics: Assist in the logistics of equipment transfers between sites, tracking shipping, installation, and qualification.  ·       RD and Manufacturing Integration: Promote effective integration between RD and Manufacturing teams, bridging technical language and ensuring engineering decisions are applied in production.   3. Technical knowledge in Python, C#, and/or LabVIEW is desirable.  Languages  ·       Portuguese: Native.  ·       English: Mandatory  Advanced/Fluent (B2/C1 level).  ·       Spanish: Bilingual  Desirable.  Soft Skills  (Aligned with HwIT Values)  ·       Superar (Overcome): Resilience to resolve technical issues under pressure in remote factory environments.  ·       Inovar (Innovate): Drive to find creative solutions to optimize assembly lines and identify root causes with the engineering team.  ·       Desenvolver (Develop): Active participation in team knowledge sharing and continuous personal development in complex NPI environments.

title: Desenvolvedor packaging fotonico pl
description:
Empresa está contratando Desenvolvedor packaging fotonico pl em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

JOB MISSION   HwIT is seeking a Packaging  Product Development Engineer focused on optical commutations products. You will be a key technical contributor supporting the hardware lifecycle of our photonic modules  from assisting in mechanical/thermal simulations and 3D CAD design to the execution, validation, and optimization of cleanroom packaging processes.  Your main focus will be a hands-on environment bridging RD design with manufacturing reality: supporting multiphysics simulations, detailing micro-assemblies, executing DOEs (Design of Experiments) for method validation, and technically investigating root causes to ensure structural integrity and maximize yield in global scale production.   SCOPE  RESPONSIBILITIES   1. Product Development and Validation  ·       Mechanical  Optomechanical Design for Packaging: Develop 3D CAD models and detailed 2D manufacturing drawings for high-precision optoelectronic packages, test fixtures, and structural assemblies, applying GDT standards.  ·       Multiphysics  Thermal Simulation: Conduct Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) to simulate thermal dissipation, mechanical stress, and structural integrity of photonic modules.  ·       Prototyping  Design Validation: Support the rapid prototyping phase and work closely with the Reliability testing team to validate simulation models against empirical data from testing (e.g., Telcordia GR-468, MIL-STD).  2. Process Development and Validation  ·       Critical Parameter Optimization: Assist in defining and optimizing critical process parameters such as die attach (e.g., conductive epoxies, eutectic soldering), wire bonding, and optical alignment.  ·       Encapsulation Techniques: Develop hermetic and semi-hermetic encapsulation techniques for photonic modules.  ·       Material Qualification: Validate new materials, adhesives, and sealing processes according to high-reliability standards.  3. Yield Optimization and Troubleshooting  ·       Root Cause Investigation: Run investigative activities in cleanroom processes to detect the root cause of issues affecting the yield and assembly times of photonic components.  ·       Design of Experiments (DOE): Run DOEs to characterize processes, define critical variables, and find the best assembly recipes.  ·       SPC Alignment: Validate and approve operational methods and process parameters consistent with the Statistical Process Control (SPC) required by Product Engineering.            4. NPI Integration and Manufacturability  ·       Design for Manufacturing (DFM): Execute DFM and development activities in packaging components under senior guidance, promoting technical alignment between suppliers and developers, and evaluating the technical feasibility of new components.  ·       Team Training: Documentation and training the operational team in the meticulous execution of complex encapsulation recipes and methodologies;  ·       Process Transference: Collaborate side-by-side with Product Engineers and Senior Packaging Engineers to validate assemblies and transfer packaging assembly processes to high-volume manufacturing sites.   CANDIDATE PROFILE   Education  Background  Essential:  ·       Bachelor s Degree in Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, Physics, or related fields.  ·       Minimum of 25 years of solid experience in microelectronic or optoelectronic packaging processes.  ·       Knowledge of structural adhesives, precision soldering, and interconnect metallurgy.  ·       Familiarity with failure analysis methodologies (SEM, EDS, X-Ray, Cross-section).  ·       Experience in optomechanical design, precision mechanics, or electronic hardware packaging.  ·       Proficiency in 3D CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Creo, Inventor) and understanding of GDT.  ·       Track record participating in thermal and structural simulations using tools like ANSYS, COMSOL, or SolidWorks Simulation.  Desirable:  ·       Experience with PICs (Photonic Integrated Circuits) and fiber-to-chip interfaces.  ·       Knowledge of reliability standards (MIL-STD-883, Telcordia GR-468, or NASA EEE-INST-002).  ·       Experience with continuous improvement tools (Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing).  ·       Knowledge of automation programming in Python, C#, or LabVIEW.  ·       Experience designing complex hermetic packages (e.g., Butterfly, TO-can) and managing micro-assembly tolerances.  ·       Background in designing customized mechanical fixtures for High-Temperature Operating Life (HTOL) and environmental testing.  Languages  ·       Portuguese: Native;   ·       English: Mandatory  Advanced/Fluent (B2/C1 level) for day-to-day communication with international partners.  ·       Spanish: Desirable.

Apoiar na configuração e operação de ambientes Kubernetes (EKS) e serviços AWS como RDS, Secrets Manager, VPC e IAM. title: Gerente executivo(a) de comunicação e relações institucionais
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Gerente executivo(a) de comunicação e relações institucionais em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

A Fundação FEAC é uma organização da sociedade civil, com sede em Campinas/SP, que há mais de seis décadas atua na promoção da equidade e do desenvolvimento social sustentável.  O Gerente Executivo(a) de Comunicação e Relações Institucionais será responsável por liderar a estratégia de comunicação e relacionamento institucional da Fundação, fortalecendo seu posicionamento, reputação e presença no ecossistema social. Atuará na construção de narrativas institucionais, na articulação com stakeholders estratégicos e na definição de agendas, espaços e parcerias prioritárias para ampliar a relevância, a influência e o impacto da organização.    PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:  Estratégia de Comunicação e Posicionamento Institucional   Desenvolver e implementar a estratégia integrada de comunicação institucional, posicionamento e reputação da Fundação;  Definir diretrizes de narrativa, presença institucional e relacionamento com stakeholders prioritários;  Identificar oportunidades estratégicas de visibilidade, participação institucional e incidência em agendas alinhadas à missão da organização;  Em parceria com as áreas fins da Fundação, estruturar a promover eventos proprietários que divulguem temas chave para o posicionamento estratégico da Fundação;  Fortalecer a imagem institucional da Fundação junto aos diferentes públicos de interesse.    Relações Institucionais e Parcerias   Desenvolver e gerir relacionamentos com organizações da sociedade civil, órgãos públicos, redes, empresas, academias, institutos, fundações e demais atores estratégicos;  Estruturar e acompanhar parcerias institucionais e ações de articulação que ampliem o impacto e a legitimidade da Fundação;  Representar a organização em eventos, fóruns, conselhos, conferências e espaços de diálogo estratégico.    Comunicação Externa   Coordenar a produção de conteúdos institucionais e estratégicos para diferentes canais e públicos, garantindo o alinhamento entre conteúdo, público de interesse e canal de comunicação;  Liderar o relacionamento com imprensa, assessorias, agências e parceiros de comunicação, buscando gerar capital reputacional para a Fundação em todas as ações da área;  Garantir consistência de linguagem, identidade institucional e posicionamento em campanhas, materiais e canais institucionais;  Supervisionar estratégias de comunicação digital, redes sociais, publicações institucionais e relatórios.    Comunicação Interna e Engajamento   Desenvolver, em parceria com a área de Gente e Cultura, iniciativas e estratégias de comunicação interna e engajamento voltadas ao fortalecimento da cultura institucional, da experiência do colaborador e do senso de pertencimento, alinhadas aos valores e direcionadores estratégicos da Fundação;  Estruturar canais, fluxos e ações de comunicação que promovam transparência, integração, alinhamento institucional e fortalecimento do senso de pertencimento das equipes;  Garantir coerência entre a comunicação institucional externa e a experiência interna, fortalecendo a cultura organizacional, a reputação e os atributos da marca, a reputação, a cultura e o alinhamento organizacional.    Gestão e Governança   Elaborar e acompanhar o planejamento estratégico e o orçamentário da área;  Definir indicadores e acompanhar métricas de reputação, alcance, engajamento e efetividade da comunicação institucional;  Liderar a equipe e os parceiros externos, garantindo alinhamento estratégico, qualidade técnica e integração das iniciativas;  Estruturar processos, políticas e fluxos relacionados à comunicação e às relações institucionais.    REQUISITOS:  Formação: Relações Institucionais, Comunicação,  Marketing ou áreas correlatas. Desejável pós-graduação ou MBA em Comunicação, Relações Institucionais, Relações Institucionais, Gestão Estratégica, Marketing, Administração ou áreas correlatas.Idiomas:  Inglês nível fluente/avançado.  Conhecimentos Específicos:   Comunicação institucional e posicionamento: domínio de estratégias voltadas à reputação, posicionamento e coerência narrativa da organização junto a públicos internos e externos;  Comunicação interna e engajamento: capacidade de estruturar estratégias de comunicação interna em parceria com Gente e Cultura, promovendo alinhamento, cultura e engajamento;  Marketing institucional e canais de comunicação: experiência na gestão de canais digitais, imprensa e fornecedores, assegurando presença institucional;  Articulação e parcerias estratégicas: habilidade de negociação e estruturação de parcerias e acordos institucionais que ampliem impacto e alcance da organização;  Gestão de eventos e presença institucional: capacidade de planejar e executar eventos e ações de relacionamento com foco em posicionamento e articulação estratégica;  Planejamento e gestão da comunicação: habilidade para desenvolver e implementar planos integrados de comunicação e relacionamento alinhados à estratégia institucional;  Narrativa territorial e institucional: capacidade de traduzir aprendizados e evidências emergentes dos territórios em mobilização e fortalecimento reputacional;

O objetivo principal da função é contribuir para a maturidade dos processos organizacionais, garantindo rastreabilidade documental, aderência a normas técnicas (como ISO 9001 e ISO 13485) e suporte às atividades de assuntos regulatórios, atuando em estreita colaboração com as áreas parceiras. Contribuir com o mapeamento de processos (AS IS / TO BE), elaboração de fluxogramas e identificação de oportunidades de melhoria, utilizando ferramentas como 5W2H, PDCA e Diagrama de Ishikawa.  Prestar suporte às atividades de Assuntos Regulatórios voltadas a dispositivos médicos, incluindo organização documental para submissões e acompanhamento de exigências da ANVISA.  Acompanhar e consolidar indicadores de desempenho de processos e qualidade, auxiliando na elaboração de dashboards e relatórios gerenciais.  Apoiar a padronização de rotinas, elaboração de POPs e disseminação de ferramentas da qualidade nas diferentes áreas do instituto.  Dar suporte geral à área em atividades administrativas, organização de evidências para auditorias internas e externas, e atualização de dados nos sistemas de gestão.       Modelo de Trabalho    Vaga 100% Presencial   Bolsista (Contrato de 1 ano)     Requisitos e Qualificações     Formação: Cursando Ensino Superior em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Biomédica, Farmácia, Química ou áreas correlatas.  Disponibilidade: 30 horas semanais, com flexibilidade para o período diurno.  Ferramentas: Pacote Office intermediário (foco em Excel para análise de dados e Word para elaboração documental).  Competências: Perfil organizado, analítico e detalhista, com boa comunicação oral e escrita, proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.      Diferenciais     Conhecimento prévio em normas ISO (9001, 13485) ou sistemas de gestão da qualidade.  Experiência ou interesse em mapeamento de processos e ferramentas de melhoria contínua.  Familiaridade com o setor de dispositivos médicos e assuntos regulatórios (ANVISA/RDC).  Domínio de ferramentas digitais de produtividade e colaboração (Notion, Trello, Miro ou similares).

Quem somos e o que fazemos     Nossa missão é impactar vidas e organizações, apoiando empresas na tomada de decisões críticas relacionadas a pessoas e crescimento, por meio de  soluções especializadas em recrutamento, projetos e consultoria em talentos   . Atuamos de forma próxima aos clientes, entendendo profundamente seus contextos de negócio, desafios e objetivos de longo prazo.    Oferecemos um ambiente inclusivo, dinâmico e orientado a performance, com forte investimento em desenvolvimento profissional, tecnologia e inteligência de mercado.    O que oferecemos     Remuneração competitiva e pacote de benefícios atrativo;   Modelo de trabalho híbrido;   Cultura orientada a bem-estar, performance sustentável e desenvolvimento contínuo;   Programas estruturados de treinamento em vendas consultivas e liderança;   Investimento constante em tecnologia e inteligência artificial para apoiar decisões comerciais;   Programas globais de reconhecimento e incentivo;   Oportunidades reais de mobilidade e crescimento no Brasil e no exterior.     Suas responsabilidades     Como Consultor(a) Comercial, sua atuação será fortemente estratégica e consultiva, com foco em  desenvolver negócios, estruturar soluções customizadas e construir parcerias de longo prazo   . Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:    Prospecção ativa e desenvolvimento de novos clientes, com foco em  vendas complexas e consultivas   ;   Gestão de contas estratégicas e relacionamento com decisores e lideranças de diferentes níveis;   Diagnóstico profundo das necessidades dos clientes, traduzindo desafios de negócio em soluções de recrutamento e talentos;   Condução de negociações comerciais e gestão de contratos, considerando ciclos de venda mais longos e múltiplos stakeholders;   Atuação integrada com times de recrutamento, participando do desenho da estratégia de busca como diferencial da proposta de valor;   Acompanhamento do processo de contratação e garantia da entrega de valor ao cliente;   Análise de mercado, tendências e mapeamento competitivo para apoiar decisões comerciais;   Visitas a clientes e participação ativa em reuniões estratégicas.      Quem procuramos     Buscamos profissionais com perfil consultivo, visão de negócio e alta capacidade relacional, que tenham:    Experiência prévia em vendas B2B complexas ou consultivas;   Capacidade de atuar com múltiplos stakeholders e influenciar decisores;   Forte orientação a resultados, sem abrir mão de ética e qualidade na entrega;   Habilidade para construir relações de confiança de longo prazo com clientes e candidatos;   Experiência prévia ou atuação próxima a processos de recrutamento e seleção será considerada um diferencial, mas não é um requisito obrigatório.   Pensamento analítico, curiosidade intelectual e capacidade de entender diferentes modelos de negócio;   Boa comunicação, presença executiva e habilidade de negociação;   Graduação completa;   Inglês avançado.     Nosso compromisso com a diversidade     Na Robert Half, acreditamos que diversidade de experiências, perspectivas e histórias fortalece nossos resultados. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e equitativo, onde cada pessoa pode ser quem é e atingir seu máximo potencial.    Faça parte da nossa história     Se você busca uma posição comercial estratégica, com impacto real nos negócios dos clientes e na carreira das pessoas, venha construir o futuro com a Robert Half.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:   Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com o perfil de grandes contas, através das atuações porta a porta, Leads direcionados e também por construções de conexões e relacionamentos;   Atuar de forma consultiva, compreendendo as dores e oportunidades dos clientes para propor soluções completas de valor agregado ao negócio;   Gerir todo o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento e onboarding do cliente sendo usuário modelo dos sistemas da companhia;   Sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros de negócio e monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento da concorrência e oportunidades de crescimento para a sua região de atuação;   Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes de produtos e operações para garantir a melhor entrega ao cliente;   Ser consultivo para atuar no detalhe durante as negociações sobre os serviços financeiros do Mercado Pago, Meios de Pagamento e Software de Gestão;    Requisitos:   Ter disponibilidade para atuar em Campinas, SP. Possuir carro próprio.    Nós lhe propomos:   Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.   Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.   Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.   Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)   O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas. Requisitos:   Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.   Possuir CNH "B" e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.   Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).   Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar em Campinas e Região.    Nós lhe propomos:   Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.   Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores. title: Especialista de Consolidação/Consolidation Specialist - Oportunidade também para PCD♿
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Especialista de Consolidação/Consolidation Specialist - Oportunidade também para PCD♿ em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:    The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries.   The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad.    KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:     Quarterly package review    - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope.  - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions.  - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process.  - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies.  - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region.    Group analyses    - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators.    One-off items    - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual.  - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope.  - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data.    OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:    The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable.    REQUIREMENTS:    Education:   Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant).   Experience:   Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing.   Languages:   Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable).    Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:     Technical Skills:   Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel); experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable).   Soft Skills:   Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement.   Essential Qualities:   Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning.    In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Learning Support Teacher em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Overview:   The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.    Core Responsibilities:    Student Support & Intervention    Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.   Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.   Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.   Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.   Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.   Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.   Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.   Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.   Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans.   Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success. PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:  The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries. The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad. KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:  Quarterly package review   - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope. - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions. - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process. - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies. - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region. Group analyses   - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators. One-off items   - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual. - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope. - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data. OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:  The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable. REQUIREMENTS:  Education:  Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant). Experience:  Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing. Languages:  Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable). Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:  Technical Skills:  Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel); experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable). Soft Skills:  Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement. Essential Qualities:  Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning. In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Learning Support Teacher em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Overview:   The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.  Core Responsibilities:  Student Support & Intervention  Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.  Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.  Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.  Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.  Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.  Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.  Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.  Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.  Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans.  Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.  Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.  Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.  Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.  Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.  Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.  Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.  Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.  Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.  Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.  Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.  Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.  Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.  Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).  Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.   Collaboration  Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.  Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.  Monitor students’ progress and well-being.  Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.  Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning.  Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.  Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.  Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.  Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.  Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.   Operational and Professional Conduct  Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.  Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.  Maintain accurate student records.  Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.  Participate in professional development opportunities.  Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.  Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.  Follow the  EAC Safeguarding Guide.   Other duties, as assigned.  Working Conditions:  Walk on paths and rough terrain  May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up   POSITION REQUIREMENTS  Minimum Education Required:    BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent  Minimum Experience Required:  Five years of teaching experience, preferred  Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.  Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.   Specific Knowledge:  Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.  Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.  Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards.   Other Skills (Desirable):  Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.  Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.  Collegial and collaborative.  Innovative and creative.  Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.   English level required:  C1 or above  Portuguese level required:  none for teachers instructing in English  C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese  Child Safeguarding  Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children.  We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct.  At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.  EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion  EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Sr ai engineer - brazil
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Sr ai engineer - brazil em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior AI Engineer PITZ | Remote | Reports to CTOA trillion-dollar industry still runs on phone calls. We're building the intelligence that replaces it. PITZ is the infrastructure layer for the global automotive aftermarket. A mechanic speaks — in Spanish, Portuguese, or English, in a noisy shop — and our system diagnoses the failure, identifies the exact part, selects the supplier, underwrites credit, and executes the order. No screen. No typing. No human in the loop. We're live in Mexico and Brazil. Entering the US this year. And we need someone to build the brain behind all of it. Why this role existsWe're not hiring a cog for an AI team. There is no AI team yet. You'd be the first dedicated AI hire. You'll work directly with the CEO to design and build the entire intelligence layer — voice pipeline, recommendation engine, credit scoring, and the data flywheel that makes everything compound. If you deliver, you become Head of AI within 12 months. Not as a title bump — because you'll have built the thing from scratch and no one will know it better than you. This is a role for someone who's been a Senior ML Engineer or AI Lead somewhere and knows they're ready for more — but hasn't had the chance to prove it because there's always someone above them. Here, there's no one above you. Just the problem and the product. What you'll buildThe voice-to-action pipeline. Mechanic speech in noisy shops → intent extraction → diagnostic prediction → SKU mapping from millions of parts → order execution. Three languages. Regional slang. Background noise. Real world, not a lab. The recommendation engine. Right part, right seller, right price, right delivery. This is where margin lives. Every percentage point of improvement moves real revenue. The credit scoring models. Behavioral underwriting for mechanics with no credit history. Turn operational data — order frequency, payment patterns, voice engagement — into financial signals. The data flywheel. Every interaction makes the system smarter. You design the architecture that turns daily transactions into compounding intelligence. US market integrations. Connect PITZ to Identifix, ALLDATA, OBD platforms, Parts Tech, Mitchell1. Adapt models for the US vehicle fleet and English-speaking mechanics. What you bring3-5 years building ML/AI systems in production. Not notebooks. Not demos. Systems that real users interact with daily and that break in interesting ways. NLP or voice experience. You've worked with speech recognition, intent extraction, text classification, or conversational AI. Bonus if it was in noisy, multilingual, or domain-specific environments. Full-stack ML instincts. You can train a model, build the data pipeline, optimize inference, deploy it, and monitor it. You don't wait for a platform team — you are the platform team. Builder mentality. You've worked in startups or fast-moving environments. You ship fast. You make decisions with 70% of the data. You'd rather build something imperfect today than plan something perfect for next quarter. Fluent English required. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred. You'll work with mechanics, ops teams, and partners across three countries. RequirementsTimezone: Must be available during US/Lat Am business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async. Commitment: This is a full-time, dedicated position. If you're currently juggling multiple roles — this isn't a fit. We need 100%. Travel: Periodic travel to Mexico City and São Paulo. You'll visit workshops, hear mechanics, and see the product in action. If you've never left your desk to watch a user interact with your model — this will change that. title: Senior software engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior software engineer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Context We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past few months, achieving 5x revenue growth in the last 12 months and a 10x increase in usage over the same period. As we continue on this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to support our rapidly scaling infrastructure and ensure we can meet the demands of our ever-growing user base. Mission As a Full-Stack Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize scalable applications. You will own features end-to-end and work closely with stakeholders to take ideas from concept to release, maintain & scale. This role demands a hands-on approach, strong motivation, and a drive to seek the best solutions while maintaining high-quality standards. Key Responsibilities Own Features from 0 to 1: Take complete ownership of features, collaborating with your teammates and stakeholders to define requirements, design solutions, and deliver them to production. Ensure every detail is addressed through to the finish line. Scalable Infrastructure: Collaborate with infrastructure teams to design systems that efficiently handle increasing traffic and usage. Build and Scale Applications: Develop and maintain scalable, high-quality features and applications. Ensure Code Quality by Promoting the adoption of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and maintaining high standards for reliability and maintainability. Integrations Between Frontend and Backend: Design and build systems that simplify and enhance integrations between front-end and back-end applications, enabling seamless communication and efficient data exchange. Support Collaboration: Partner with the support team to diagnose and resolve complex issues, improving tools and processes to enhance the customer experience. Observability and Monitoring: Strengthen our observability by integrating and improving tools that provide insights into application health and performance. Whom Are We looking For We seek a Senior Software Engineer who thrives in high-growth environments and combines technical expertise with relentless motivation. You'll take pride in building scalable systems, owning features end-to-end, and delivering user value. Key Qualifications Node.js, Type Script & React Expertise: Extensive experience with Node JS, TS, & React, leveraging modern development patterns and best practices. Event-Driven Architecture: Proven experience building event-driven systems using tools like message brokers or similar technologies. TDD Focus: Commitment to Test-Driven Development (TDD) and a strong track record of delivering high-quality code. Scalable Applications: Experience designing and maintaining systems that perform under heavy traffic and scale with user demand. Monitoring Tools: Proficiency with observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) for monitoring and maintaining system health. Ownership Mindset: Demonstrated ability to take ownership of features, from initial design through production release. Ultra-motivated and Hands-On: Eager to dive into the code and solve challenging problems with enthusiasm and focus. Seek the Best Solutions: Continuously evaluate and implement the best tools, technologies, and methodologies to solve problems effectively and innovate within the team. Thrives in Chaos: Ability to embrace and adapt to the fast-paced, dynamic environment of a high-scaling startup, maintaining focus and effectiveness amidst ambiguity. Bonus Qualifications Media Processing: Experience with video and audio processing, streaming technologies, or related workloads. AI Integration: Worked with artificial intelligence systems or tools, either integrating AI features into applications or ensuring smooth collaboration with AI-based solutions. Start-Up Experience: Prior experience working at a fast-growing, large-scale startup is a strong plus. Diverse Technical Knowledge: A valuable asset is familiarity with additional programming languages, design patterns, or architectural paradigms.

They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15 M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale. The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable. What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\" Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2 E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites. Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author. Supabase in production. Postgre SQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. Type Script primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, Hub Spot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role. Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or Web Sockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product Saa S background, not agency or consultancy. Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications. Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent Postgre SQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving. How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty. What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15 M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you. To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS. You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not. The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.  As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will  Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure. Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation. Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.   You Are Likely To Succeed If  You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools  to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)   What We Offer:  Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package  Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. About The Role  As a Senior Backend Engineer , you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions , creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space –  problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate . What You’ll Do:  Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform. You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine  and contribute to: AI Agents  – Automating complex decision-making and workflows OCR & Document Processing  – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents  Intelligent Data Mapping  – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile  Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM  – The AI-powered backbone  of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows  while replacing outdated, manual processes Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry  – A Typeform-like system  built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere  Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations. Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture. Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability.  What we’re looking for  7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript. Strong experience with Node.js Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability. Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices. Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry. Strong hands-on experience with Nest.js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services. Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications. Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management. Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.g., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies. Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling. Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).  What we offer  Collaborative and innovative work environment Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Budget for English lessons.  Why Join XILO?  A great tech startup  – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact Endless career growth  – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale Strong leadership & backing  – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs  Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration. Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes. Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations. Automation, Integration & AI Implementation  Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript). Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.  IT Administration & Security  Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365). Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.  Required Qualifications & Skills  Technical Experience:  5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.  Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:  Communication:  Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking:  Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making:  Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.  Benefits & Compensation  Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Technical Product Owner em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US  Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE  We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner  to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do  Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.  WHAT IT TAKES  The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.  Key Skills  Visionary Leadership:  Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts:  Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application:  Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication:  Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding:  Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration:  Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results:  Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.  Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big  - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious  - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action  - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together  - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.  WHAT WE OFFER  Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.  OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.
